name: latex-codex
description: Local LaTeX and Markdown editor with Codex and optional DeepSeek Harness AI backends.

interface.shortDescription: Edit LaTeX and Markdown with live previews.
interface.longDescription: A small local editor with automatic local TeX compilation and a bundled PDF.js viewer in the Codex browser side panel. Supports pdfLaTeX/XeLaTeX directives, BibTeX and SyncTeX, plus Markdown live HTML preview and optional XeLaTeX PDF rendering for Obsidian callouts and TikZ. Requires Python 3.10+; PDF compilation needs an existing TeX installation. No Poppler or Node installation is needed. PDF.js reads page metadata and text positions, and pages render on demand in the browser. Can be selected as the preferred LaTeX workflow in project instructions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open my LaTeX file with LaTeX Codex in the side panel.
